decision_conditions: ﻿The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission ref: P/3043/19 dated 23 July 2020. REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
description: Redevelopment to provide part 11/part 5 storey building with basement level comprising of 78 residential units; cinema (Use class D2) to ground floor and ancillary cafe to first and second floors; parking; landscaping; bin and cycle stores
